summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of 6 new e-commerce features. All features are working correctly. Price filter, checkout flow, thank you page, social login, contact page, floating actions, and shop expiry features all verified.
passed_tests: Homepage shows price filter brackets (Tất cả giá, Dưới 500K, 500K-1M, 1M-5M, Trên 5M)
Click 'Dưới 500K' bracket filters products correctly - shows 3 products under 500K (Minimalist Succulent Pot 320K, Handwoven Rattan Baskets 450K, Ceramic Coffee Set 380K)
Storefront /shop/the-elite-shop shows price filter and 6-column product grid (lg:grid-cols-6) with centered text
Add product to cart on storefront, open cart drawer, click 'Đặt hàng' opens full-screen checkout overlay
Checkout overlay has shipping form (name, phone, email, address, note) and order summary sidebar
Fill checkout form and submit redirects to /shop/the-elite-shop/thank-you with order details
Thank you page shows order confirmation with green checkmark, order ID (ORD-xxx), items list, and total
Auth modal has Google and Facebook social login buttons with proper icons (Tiếp tục với Google, Tiếp tục với Facebook)
Click Google login button simulates login and reloads page (mock social login working)

Contact page at /shop/the-elite-shop/contact shows phone (0912 345 678), email (hello@theeliteshop.com), address, business hours (T2-T7: 8:00-18:00), social links (Facebook, Instagram), and message form
Floating info button (amber) navigates to /shop/the-elite-shop/contact when clicked on storefront
Admin login (admin@thewishop.com/admin123), Shops tab shows 'Ngày hết hạn' column with date picker input
Shop expiry overlay shows 'Cửa hàng tạm ngưng' blocking message when shop has past expiry date
critical_code_review_comments: Mock data changes (like expiry date) don't persist across full page navigations - this is expected behavior for a mock-only frontend without backend persistence
